summary: This bill amends the Public Health Service Act to bar the NIH Director from conducting or funding any research on dogs or cats that involves USDA pain/distress categories D or E, effective 90 days after enactment.

This directly restricts a category of NIH-funded activities, which would reduce federal spending on those specific research projects. The effect is narrow and not the primary purpose of the legislation, so the impact is minor and tangential rather than a broad fiscal policy change.
